translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Eseda ibugua kinila Hamanala tomo nami̱ya ibalibu lenego ogo
Kini ibugua Esedahondo lalu, Kuini Eseda-o í̠ore agile hame ledebe. I̱na í̠hondo mbirale timbuniorebi i̱naga dindi timbuni ngogo mendehayagi í̠ tuwua ngi lariyagua nde nguliya langi, lene.

Ani layagola Esedahanda ladai bialu lalu, Kini-o ayu mbiraga Hamana libu tomo timbuni nami̱ya ibulene karulapedabe. Tomo timbuni ayu noledago irane i̱naga horo timbuni mbira tagira ibiragonaga nami̱ya laro, lene.
Ani layago hale halu kini ibugua Hamana lamialu tomo nole Eseda andaga mbaliya abale ibabe lalu lamini. Ai kini Hamanala Esedahanda tomo dawa manda manda bialu bereagoha pene.
Ani puwa ti waini iba nalu biruwa kinihanda Esedahondo hale halu lalu, Eseda-o i̱hondo mbirale ngi larego ta nabi nguleberogo ai í̠naga hame ledego abale langi, lene.
Ani layagola Esedahanda kinihondo ladai bialu lalu,
Kini-o i̱na í̠hondo hale harogo bibahende e̱ lai holeyagua nde Hamana libunaga tomo halu mende manda manda bu wiaguago yawi lone ibalibu, lene.
Hamanahanda Modegai bo wahole manda manda binigo ogo

Hamana ibu tomo nalu berenego nai halu andaga pole tagira pialu howa ibunaga bu miniha dungu lalu turu hama tagira pene. Ibu tagira puwa handalu hearia Modegai ibu nde kini anda haneni berearia hendene. Ani hondowa Hamana ibu miniha tandaga timbuni hama pene.
Ani puwa Hamana ibugua ibu damene hearu íbu ngoai hadaba lowa ibu one Seresebi ti haru mandagi birami̱ya íbu lowa ti haru berene.

Ti bibahende íbu ngoaiho bereagola tinaga deni Hamanahanda ibuninaga mini yaraga halu hene. Ibugua tihondo lamialu ibunaga muni dabudabubi dewaore ngo lene. Ani bialu kinihanda ibu agali dunini timbuni mbira helalu biabe timbuni mbira mo ngialu kininaga agali haguane bu hearu bibahende ibu andaneha helaya lalu lamini.

Ani bialu Hamana ibugua laabo halu lalu, Ai Kuini Esedahanda Kini iya hangunaga tomo timbuniore dawa haya. Ibugua agali maru hearu tomo nami̱ya ibalimu naleore. Ani bialu yawibi nde lone nami̱ya ibalibu laya.
Anigo ai Yudali Modegai heago kini anda haneni bereago handarugola i̱naga bu miniha tandaga timbuniore ira daradagua biya. Anidagua biyagome mbirale bayale ayu larogoni bame nagalone haya, lene.

Ani layagola ibu one biagomebi ibu damene berearu tiguabi lamialu lalu, Miniha genda halu mini burugu nale waha. Ai í̠na agali karuhondo ira luni manda mida pira kira (20) dibu hongowa yawi egerebagi í̠na kini hale halu Modegai abale ira ogoriani bo derela helo lamibe. Ani bialu mani í̠naga miniha dungulo howa tomo no pole ani bibe, lalu tigua lamini. Hamana ibugua bi hale howa agali bu hearuhondo lalu, Ira luni mbira Modegai pume manogo bia buwa bo derela helonaga dibu hongole pudaba, lene.
